params.body:
Merge after Trendwolves/gentells-pipeline (images in a piece's text): without it an image still works in the Studio, but shows a false "No source for this line" and reaches gentells.com with a relative address.

**Images in a piece**
For posts and articles, not decks:
- Paste or drop an image into the paragraph being written: it goes in right after that paragraph. Drop it on the piece, or use **Add an image**, and it goes at the end.
- Each image is a paragraph of its own, one markdown line with the same relative upload address a cover gets (`/articles/upload-cover`). Under the picture: its caption, which is the alt text, editable in place, and Remove.
- It is saved like every other change, with Save. `imageOf`, `imageLine` and `insertAfter` in `piece.js`, with tests.

**Smaller**
- While the conversation waits for an answer: three pulsing aqua dots instead of a static ellipsis (still with reduced motion).
- The Write half of the mode switch is ink instead of red; red on the half you work in read as a warning.
- Curate's overview: "On gentells.com" takes two fifths of the width (it was a fixed 340 px), five items per kind instead of three.
- Curate's Posts tab: in review first, then live. Every row has **Edit**, which opens it in Write. In review shows whether the post can go live (`GET /articles/:id/review`) and **Put live** when it can, otherwise why not ("not ready: no sources cited"). Live has View and **Take offline**, confirmed, back to review. The pipeline enforces the same gate on publish.

**Checked**
- Against a local pipeline: an image pasted into a paragraph and one added at the end, saved, captions edited; a PDF post imported with three images in place; Posts tab with a not-ready post in review (Put live hidden, reason shown) and live posts with Take offline.
- `npm test`: 13 passed (2 new). `vite build` passes.
params.title: Studio: images in a piece, posts decided from Curate's list, Write in ink
